title: Start August by Verifying One Cached State Boundary
teaser: A value that looks stable in one session may be reconstructed differently after a real restart.
message: Persist a small fixture kill the process relaunch and compare the exact stored fields against the expected state.

title: Pin One Astrology Result to Its Timezone Provenance
teaser: A reproducible chart needs more than a city label and local wall time.
message: For one sample record zone identifier tzdb version UTC instant coordinates and resulting position together.

title: Measure Touch Targets in the Densest Toolbar
teaser: Compact controls can become inaccessible even when every icon is technically tappable.
message: Inspect the most crowded action row and verify every target meets the documented minimum size and spacing rule.

title: Compare Free and PRO Actions on the Same Record
teaser: Shared screens can accidentally expose premium actions when entitlement checks are scattered.
message: Open one identical fixture under Free and PRO profiles and compare the available actions with the entitlement contract.

title: Trace Intermediate Values Through One Calculation
teaser: A final number alone cannot show where a deterministic engine diverged.
message: Use a reference fixture and assert the important parsed inputs intermediate values and final output in one test.

title: Rehash Every File Inside a Backup Manifest
teaser: An archive opening successfully does not prove its internal files are unchanged.
message: Create a backup recompute each listed file checksum and compare every value with the manifest before restore.

title: Search Turkish Locale for English System Leakage
teaser: Localized content can still expose another language in permission errors and empty states.
message: Run representative denial validation sharing and empty-state flows in Turkish and verify no unintended English copy remains.

title: Round-Trip CSV Text with Quotes Commas and Newlines
teaser: CSV bugs often hide until a field contains multiple quoting edge cases at once.
message: Export a controlled field containing quotes commas and a line break then import it and assert exact string equality.

title: Exercise a Date Range Across February Boundaries
teaser: Range logic can drift when month length and leap-year rules interact.
message: Run equivalent ranges through leap and non-leap Februaries and verify inclusive day counts and endpoints.

title: Keep Synthetic PIN Values Out of Diagnostics
teaser: Masked input on screen can still leak through logs or crash metadata.
message: Trigger a controlled PIN failure with a known sentinel and verify the literal value is absent from diagnostic outputs.

title: Recheck a Packaged SVG Against Asset Provenance
teaser: Optimization can change the shipped file while leaving the source manifest untouched.
message: Trace one SVG from source through packaging and record the expected source and packaged hashes with the transformation step.

title: Lock a Chaldean Letter Mapping with a Small Fixture
teaser: A single correct name total can miss an error in one character mapping.
message: Build a fixture covering representative letters and verify both per-letter values and the resulting deterministic total.

title: Announce a Dynamic Result to Assistive Technology
teaser: A visible result change may be silent to users who do not see the screen.
message: Complete a calculation and verify the updated status is announced once with meaningful text and without duplicate noise.

title: Explain Network-Required Actions While Offline
teaser: An endless spinner is not an acceptable offline state for a blocked action.
message: With a Free profile offline trigger a network-only action and confirm the UI gives a clear reason plus a safe recovery path.

title: Verify Embedded Font Coverage in a Turkish PDF
teaser: Characters that render locally can fail in another viewer when the font is not embedded.
message: Generate a report containing Turkish-specific glyphs and inspect the PDF structure to confirm the required font is embedded.

title: Reject Unknown Theme Tags in Content Shards
teaser: Free-form metadata values gradually fragment filtering and analytics.
message: Pass one invalid theme through the content validator and confirm only documented canonical tags are accepted.

title: Refresh Daily State After Resuming Across Midnight
teaser: An app left in the background can return showing yesterday's daily content.
message: Simulate suspension across a local date boundary resume and verify date-dependent state refreshes to the new day.

title: Disambiguate Cities That Share the Same Name
teaser: A city name alone is not enough to guarantee the intended coordinates.
message: Create two same-name location fixtures and confirm country region and coordinates are exposed before the user commits a choice.

title: Define the Contract for a 24:00 Birth-Time Input
teaser: Boundary clock notation can be normalized differently by separate parsers.
message: Test 24:00 and 00:00 through the supported input path and assert the documented reject-or-normalize behavior consistently.

title: Preserve Referential Integrity During Merge Restore
teaser: Colliding local identifiers can silently attach child records to the wrong parent.
message: Merge two fixtures with intentional ID collisions and verify remapping keeps every relationship connected to the correct entity.

title: Calculate Circular Distance Across Zero Degrees
teaser: Linear subtraction gives the wrong answer near the 360-degree boundary.
message: Use 359° and 1° inputs and assert the angular-distance utility returns the documented 2° separation and direction semantics.

title: Reflect Notification Permission Denial in Settings
teaser: A toggle that stays enabled after platform denial misrepresents actual capability.
message: Deny notification permission and verify settings show the true state with an appropriate explanation and supported retry path.

title: Clear Premium Payloads When Switching to a Free Profile
teaser: Shared caches can leak previously viewed protected content across account boundaries.
message: Open premium content under PRO switch to Free and confirm protected data is absent from cache render state and accessibility surfaces.

title: Reformat Dates Immediately After a Locale Change
teaser: Changing labels without changing date formatting creates a mixed-language interface.
message: Switch a date-heavy screen from Turkish to English and verify month names ordering and numeric formatting all follow the new locale.

title: Block Parent-Directory Escapes in Export Paths
teaser: User-derived filenames must not be able to move output outside the intended directory.
message: Attempt an export with traversal-like fragments and verify path normalization keeps the file under the approved output root.

title: Give Chart Series a Non-Color Distinction
teaser: Color alone is not sufficient for users with color-vision differences.
message: Inspect a multi-series chart and confirm labels shapes patterns or another non-color cue distinguish the series.

title: Match Every Monthly CSV Header to the Canonical Schema
teaser: A reordered column list can silently corrupt parsers that assume positional fields.
message: Compare the shard header exactly with date title teaser message theme and fail validation on any deviation.

title: Remove Unnecessary Persistent Device IDs from Error Data
teaser: Long-lived identifiers increase privacy risk when diagnostics do not truly need them.
message: Inspect a controlled error payload and verify no unnecessary persistent device identifier is collected or transmitted.

title: Keep Bottom Navigation Usable at Large Text Scale
teaser: Large accessibility text can clip labels or shrink effective touch areas.
message: Increase system text scale and verify all four primary navigation destinations remain readable identifiable and tappable.

title: Scan the Release Build for Debug Service Endpoints
teaser: Production artifacts should not retain routes to localhost staging or diagnostic backends.
message: Inspect packaged configuration and strings for known debug endpoint patterns and fail the release gate if any remain.

title: Close August with an Exact Reproducible Handoff
teaser: A precise next date prevents the editorial ledger from drifting between runs.
message: Record 2034-09-01 as the next exact start and reconcile it with committed shard counts before advancing progress.
